purpose: Exact current-source Electricity/Traffic H96 mechanism control separating the prediction-connected AutoCon representation path from the contrastive AutoCon objective.
research_question: On the two high-dimensional H96 coordinates that passed the full strong-baseline matrix, does MambaTSv3AutoCon benefit from prediction-connected representation fusion and/or the AutoCon contrastive objective under exact paired controls?
architecture: All arms use one MambaTSv3 Mamba-1 patch scan. The active arm trains the AutoCon representation objective at lambda=.001 and injects that representation into the forecast through the frozen zero-initialized fusion residual. Fusion-off changes only the prediction connection. Lambda-zero retains the full fusion graph but disables only the contrastive objective.
evidence_boundary: Validation-only exploratory mechanism matrix. All jobs skip the test loader and save no predictions, metrics, or streaming artifacts.
claim_boundary: A passing contrast supports only the named implementation component on Electricity/Traffic H96. It does not establish general AutoCon causality, held-out accuracy, or universal speed.

required_before_launch: verify Electricity and Traffic fingerprints and the complete 18-job expansion
freeze all architecture, optimizer, normalization, budget, and seed settings except the registered one-factor controls
keep skip_test=true and save_predictions=false for every job
create one immutable source snapshot and fresh output root

selection_contract.freeze_rule: The MambaTSv3 architecture, data, optimizer, scheduler, budget and seeds are fixed. The only treatment changes are the named fusion switch or AutoCon lambda.

capacity_fairness_contract.common_public_budget: All three arms share chronological split, features, input/output lengths, model width, optimizer, scheduler, batch, epoch budget, patience, and normalization.
capacity_fairness_contract.fusion_control_difference: Only mamba_ts_repr_forecast_fusion changes, while AutoCon lambda remains .001.
capacity_fairness_contract.lambda_null_difference: Only AutoCon lambda changes from .001 to 0 while the fusion graph remains enabled.

phases.name: active_fusion_h96
phases.purpose: Active AutoCon contrastive objective plus prediction-connected representation fusion.

phases.name: fusion_off_h96
phases.purpose: Exact prediction-connected representation-fusion control retaining active AutoCon contrastive training.

phases.name: lambda_zero_h96
phases.purpose: Exact AutoCon contrastive-null control retaining prediction-connected representation fusion.

comparison_contract.reporting_rule: Report both contrasts for both datasets even if they fail. A local mechanism pass requires mean improvement, at least 2/3 paired wins, and no individual degradation above 2%.

stopping_rules: Do not tune lambda, fusion rank, width, or epochs after observing this matrix.
Do not promote a mechanism claim for a contrast that fails its predeclared local gate.
Do not produce or inspect held-out artifacts.
